## Summary
Added optional `Din` and `Dout` parameters to the MMI simulation functions to control the input/output port spacing (in meters). When not provided, the historical default spacing is preserved. Port placement is now explicitly symmetric about the MMI centerline at `x = W/2`, and invalid spacings that push ports outside the MMI width now raise a clear `ValueError`.
